s2.ptxt: Remove the drain plug and drain the engine oil.
After draining the oil, install the drain plug with a new gasket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Oil Filter Element Service Hole Cover

s2.ptxt: As shown in the illustration, crease the service hole cover and open it.

atten4.ptxt: Crease the service hole cover so that its fold angle is held at 90° or more.

s2.ptxt: Connect a hose (15 φ) to the supplied pipe.

atten4.ptxt: Use a hose with an inside diameter of 15 φ.

s2.ptxt: Remove the oil filter drain plug from the oil filter cap.

atten3.ptxt: Do not remove the 0 ring (for drain plug).

s2.ptxt: Insert the pipe with the hose attached into the oil filter cap.

atten3.ptxt: Insert the pipe with the 0 ring (for drain plug) attached to the oil filter cap side.

atten4.ptxt: Oil will drain from the hose, so place the end of the hose in a container beforehand.

s2.ptxt: Check that the oil has drained, and remove the pipe and O-ring (for drain plug).

atten4.ptxt: Remove the pipe by bending it sideways.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the oil filter cap.
Remove the oil filter element and O-ring (for cap) from the oil filter cap.

atten3.ptxt: Remove the O-ring (for cap) by hand without using tools, etc. to prevent damage to the O-ring groove.
